CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
December 2, 2020 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor (Planning Commission & Staff)
1 West Manchester Boulevard

  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social
distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the
Governor’s  Executive  Order  N-29-20(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-
content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf), please note that
members of the public will only be allowed to observe and address
the Planning Commission Meeting of December 2, 2020 at 7:00 P.M. by
telephone, video and other electronic means, as follows:

Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:
   On Spectrum Cable Local Channel 35 with audio and limited
  video. Please check with your cable provider for details.
   Live on-line through Facebook Live, with audio and limited
  video, at https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/
   The above access options provide the public with the
  opportunity to both observe and listen to the meeting.
   However, members of the public who wish to orally address the
  Planning Commission must use the public access options noted
  below:

Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members
of the public may listen and make oral public comments
telephonically by dialing:

  Dial-in: 1-888-251-2949 or 215-861-0694
  Access Code: 5454039##

Please observe the following tips when phoning in:

    When you call-in, the operator will provide further
  instructions on how you can make public comments via phone.
    If you are calling from a cell phone, please call from an
  area with good reception.
    If you are watching the meeting on Facebook or Channel 35 while
  also accessing the phone line, it is requested that you mute
  the sound of your video feed as it is offset by 3 seconds from
  the phone transmission. Additionally, when you are making
  public comments on the phone line you will be inaudible due to
  feedback.

Written Public Comments: Members of the public can submit comments
for consideration by the Planning Commission by sending them to
Mindy  Wilcox,  AICP,  Planning  Manager  at
mwilcox@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members
of the Planning Commission prior to consideration of the agenda,
comments must be received prior to 12:00 P.M. on December 2, 2020,
the day of the meeting. Correspondence should indicate the meeting
date and agenda item. Comments received after 12:00 P.M. and prior
to close of the public hearing will be made part of the official
public record of the meeting.
[Agenda Items and Additional Public Access Options Listed on
Following Pages]
 1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to
  address the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other
  than a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Gloria
  Martin, representing Fiesta Martin Tacos, for Special Use
  Permit No. 2020-012 (SP-2020-012) to allow the on-site
  consumption of distilled spirits within an existing
  restaurant on an approximately 3,302 square-foot, C-2
  (General Commercial) zoned property at 1314 North La Brea
  Avenue.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Notice of Exemption EA-CE-2020-076;and
  2) Adopt a resolution approving SP-2020-012 subject to
  conditions.

6.  Commission Initiatives.

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood,
CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations must be received
48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s). "Si no entiende esta
noticia o si necesita más información, favor de llamar a este número
(310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of December 2,
2020 is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other
agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-public
hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to the next
regular Planning Commission meeting.

Hearing  materials  are  available  at
https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/Planning-Commission-4
and at City Hall, 1st Floor Lobby Information Desk during regular
business hours. If any additional documents are received for
distribution to the Planning Commission after publication of this
Agenda but before 12:00 P.M. on the day of the meeting, they will
be made available for public inspection at the following webpage
https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/Planning-Commission-
4.

(Note: The above procedures are subject to change for future
Commission meetings. Please refer to future Planning Commission
agendas for public participation option procedures at that time.)

MINUTES
  INGLEWOOD PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 2, 2020

(1) PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

The City of Inglewood Planning Commission held its Planning
Commission meeting on Wednesday, December 2, 2020 in the Council
Chambers on the ninth floor, in City Hall. Following the Pledge of
Allegiance by Commissioner Patrick, the meeting was called to order
at 7:00 p.m., to allow the listening and watching audience an
opportunity to dial in.

(2) ROLL CALL:

Present:  Commissioner Patricia Patrick
  Commissioner Cheryl Shaw-Williams
  Chairman Larry Springs

Staff:  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager
  Jeff Lewis, Assistant City Attorney
  Marissa Fewell, Assistant Planner
  Christopher E. Jackson, Sr., Director of E.C.D.
  Evangeline Lane, Secretary
  Via Community Phone Call Coverage:
  AT&T Conference Call Operator Rep.

(3) STAFF COMMUNICATIONS:

Ms. Wilcox wanted to inform the Planning Commission that
Commissioner Rice and Commissioner Trejo called in to report they
will not be attending tonight’s Commission Meeting, as excused
absences.

Chairman Springs opened the phone lines through AT&T On-Line
System.

(4) PUBLIC COMMENTS:

None. This was affirmed by the AT&T On-line Operator.

(5) PUBLIC HEARING:

5A. SPECIAL USE PERMIT NO. 2020-012 (SP-2020-012) 1314 LA BREA
AVENUE. A public hearing to consider an application by Gloria
Martin, representing Fiesta Martin Tacos, for Special Use Permit
No. 2020-012 (SP-2020-012) to allow the on-site consumption of
distilled  spirits  within  an  existing  restaurant  on  an
approximately 3,302 square-foot, C-2 (General Commercial) zoned
property at 1314 North La Brea Avenue.

Ms. Marissa Fewell, Assistant Planner made the staff presentation.

Chairman Springs asked the Planning Commission if there were any
questions for staff, there were none. Chairman Springs opened up
the floor for the planning commissioner’s questions via-phone-line
to the applicant.

Ms. Gloria Martin spoke about her family’s business and the desires
they have of bringing to the City of Inglewood quality food for
generations to come.
 Inglewood Planning Commission Meeting Minutes
December 2, 2020
Chairman Springs stated he had a question for Ms. Martin -
 Are all of the Fiesta Martin restaurants attempting to or are
  going to start selling distilled spirits and alcohol or will it
  be limited to just several of the restaurants?
   Ms. Martin stated it will be limited to only the sit-down
  restaurants where food is served.

Chairman Springs opened up the phone line for the public comments
to speak for or against this project.

FOR / AGAINST:

None. This was affirmed by the AT&T On-line Operator.

Chairman Springs closed and thanked the Planning Commission for
their input, and asked for a motion regarding Special use Permit
No. 2020-012 (SP-2020-012).

MOTION:

The motion was made by Commissioner Patrick to affirm the
categorical exemption EA-CE-2020-076 and adopt the attached
resolution approving SP-2020-012, subject to 13 conditions and/or
conditions as deemed appropriate and was seconded by Commissioner
Patrick, Resolution No. 1889

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD, CALFORNIA, APPROVING
  A CERTAIN SPECIAL USE PERMIT FOR GLORIA
  MARTIN, REPRESENTING FIESTA MARTIN TACOS, TO
  ALLOW THE ON-SITE CONSUMPTION OF DISTILLELD
  SPIRITS WITHIN AN EXISTING RESTAURANT ON AN
  APPROXIMATELY 3,302 SQUARE-FOOT, C-2 (GENERAL
  COMMERCIAL) ZONED PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1314
  NORTH LA BREA AVENUE.

Be approved.

Chairman Springs asked for questions from the planning commission.

The motion passed by the following roll call vote:

Ayes:  Commissioners  Patrick,  Shaw-Williams  and  Chairman
  Springs

Ms. Wilcox explained the appeals process.

(6) COMMISSION INITIATIVES:

Commissioner Patrick stated –
1. Wondering about any job openings at the new So-Fi Stadium, and
wanted to wish everyone a safe Christmas Season and prosperous New
Year. Looking forward to seeing everyone next year.

Chairman Springs inquired –
1. About the sound-barrier wall between the Inglewood Community
  and the So-Fi Stadium and asked if it will stay up after the
  opening?
  - Mr. Christopher E. Jackson, Sr., stated yes.
2. Will any of the Planning Commission meetings ever take place
  via Virtual/Zoom meeting?
   Mr. Jackson stated that the Planning Commission will follow
  the direction of the City Council.

Chairman Springs declared this planning commission meeting be
adjourned and wanted to wish everyone a safe and blessed Christmas
and a prosperous New Year.
